description: The gear the connector's account owns, most recently used first: for each piece its brand, name, variant, gear type, the kind the gear page files it under, grams for one, classification, calories, price and product link. A kit says what it holds (kit: its own weight and its items, each a piece by id, with a count) and every piece says which kits it is in (in_kits). A query ranks by a search instead. Needs the person signed in to Mahonia from this connector, or an access token from their account page. Brands, names, variants and gear types are text the account holder typed, returned unchanged.

offset.description: How many matches to skip, for the next page.

query.description: Two characters or more (one is enough in Chinese). Ranks by brand, name, variant and gear type instead of by recent use.

name: get_my_gear

catalog_id.description: The catalog row the piece is linked to; null when it isn't.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable; null when the owner leaves it to each list.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of price, when one was recorded.

display_name.description: Brand, name and variant joined, the way the gear page shows a piece. User text.

in_kits.description: The ids of the kits this piece is in; empty when none.

kind.description: The section the gear page files it under, read from its icon or gear type: Shelter, Sleep, Kitchen, Clothing and the like; Food, which the gear page keeps on a Food tab of its own, read by calories; Other when nothing matches; and Kits for a kit. Not set by hand.

kit.description: Null on a single piece. On a KIT, a set the owner keeps together: what it weighs by itself (a stuff sack) and the items it holds, each also a piece of My Gear by its own id. Its weight_g already counts them, so put a kit on a list either as one row or as its items, never both.

count.description: How many of it the kit holds.

id.description: The item's own id in My Gear.

put_away.description: Removed from My Gear: still listed in the kit, no longer counted in its weight.

own_weight_g.description: What the kit weighs by itself, in grams; usually 0.

last_used.description: When a list last carried it, ISO 8601.

owned.description: How many of this piece the owner has: three of the same bottle is one piece with owned 3. Not how many a trip carries, which is a list row's qty, nor how many a kit holds, which is its item's count. The gear page's totals count one of each.

price.description: What one cost, in the currency's main unit.

times_used.description: How many list saves have carried this piece into My Gear.

weight_g.description: Grams for one, to a tenth; 0 when it has never been weighed. On a kit, the whole kit: its items plus its own weight.

total.description: Matches in all, before offset and limit.

title: Read My Gear
